restaurant.name: Restaurant

restaurant.metaDesc: Manage restaurant orders, ingredient stock, staff, and billing in one platform. Zeebroo is built for busy restaurant operations.

features.title: Fast table-side checkout
features.desc: Take orders and payments at the table or counter. Split bills, apply discounts, and print receipts in seconds - even during the busiest service.

features.title: Ingredient stock control
features.desc: Track raw materials and finished dishes. Get low-stock alerts before service so you never run out mid-shift and always know what to reorder.

features.title: Staff scheduling and HR
features.desc: Roster floor and kitchen teams, track hours, and manage HR records without a separate app. Every shift, every role, in one place.

features.title: Daily sales and menu reports

features.title: Promotions and campaigns
features.desc: Schedule happy hour deals, seasonal promotions, and loyalty offers from the same platform you use to run the business. Keep marketing aligned with stock.

features.title: Supplier bills and accounts
features.desc: Track what you owe suppliers, reconcile accounts, and pay bills on time - all without switching to a separate accounting tool.

steps.title: Set up your menu and stock
steps.desc: Add dishes, ingredients, and prices. Zeebroo keeps stock in sync automatically as items sell through each service.

steps.title: Train your team once

steps.title: Close each day with clarity
steps.desc: Daily sales summaries, stock movement, and outstanding supplier bills - ready before you lock up, no manual totalling required.
